data_fields.name: memberCountdownTicks
data_fields.donor_constant: per-member countdown in turns, set by the level script (np[5])

data_fields.name: exitWaitTicks
data_fields.donor_constant: HERODOORWAITTIME: default 100, minimum 0, maximum UINT32_MAX (rule row)

best_idea: A raid party enters a hostile zone as a staggered wave, each member with its own countdown, elects one leader by objective then level then score, and re-targets on fixed timers (64, 400, 16 and 200 turns) rather than in one step.
decision_why: Take the staggered-countdown wave, the leader rule and the retarget timers for enemy parties entering a zone (the party record and timers are data). Reject the hero-gate limbo mechanic (not in our rulings). Fix D1 (bounds guard always false), D2 (8-bit gate stamp) and D3 (countdown 0 never releases) in the sketch.
acceptance: Server test: a 3-member party with countdowns 0, 30 and 60 turns spawns at once and activates at turns 0, 30 and 60; the highest-level member leads; an out-of-range party id is rejected and writes nothing; a waiting member whose exit gate was replaced by turn 300 is removed, not returned.
